policy.label_mapping: Caller-supplied exact source-label mapping; no strip or case guesses
policy.language_scope: The existing lightweight ASCII-letter guard is not language detection. It accepts mixed-language strings containing an ASCII two-letter run; dataset English provenance must be checked separately.
policy.internal_dedup: Collapse normalized exact duplicates with the same mapped label only
policy.conflict_policy: Quarantine every eligible row in a normalized-text group with both labels
policy.selection_policy: Freeze eligible sample IDs before predictions; never filter by model result

ingestion.source_row_scope: One-based parsed data-record positions, excluding the header and blank CSV lines; quoted multiline cells remain one record

policy.reference_input: Explicit rows only; no default path, source, snapshot or held-out access
policy.candidate_blocking: A candidate and reference must share at least one token among the first two or last two tokens of their own template keys; same rule as DataStore.prepare
policy.witness_policy: One exclusion witness per candidate: exact ID, then equal nonempty template, then first qualifying reference in (split, id) order
policy.scope_limit: Direct cross-dataset matches only. No full all-pairs gram audit, no transitive external grouping, and no semantic paraphrase coverage. Near pairs with disjoint boundary-token blocks can remain. Internal external dedup is normalized-exact only.
policy.selection_policy: Freeze final accepted IDs before predictions; never filter by model result

policy.reference_input: Caller-supplied hashes only; no reserved text lookup or file access
policy.scope_limit: No reserved raw text is available for near-gram or semantic checks
policy.selection_policy: Freeze accepted IDs before any prediction; never filter by results

language_audit.scope: Script audit only, not a semantic language detector
